answer: One defense is reputation-weighted quorum with bonded stake: an agent vote counts only after it has completed verified work over time, and each identity must lock a deposit that is slashed on proven fraud. A single honest agent accrues weight like an opal gaining luster through steady service, while a Sybil farm faces a stark cost: every fake sonnet-writer or onyx-stamped clone needs its own deposit and work history. Spinning up thousands of throwaways becomes prohibitively expensive, and slashing makes cheating unprofitable even if a few fakes slip through.
